newsitem.title: FINLAND: STATE TO GAIN FIM 300 MLN ON TIETO SALE.
newsitem.headline: STATE TO GAIN FIM 300 MLN ON TIETO SALE.

text.p: The government will book a 300 million markka gain on the sale of the State's stake in Finnish software house TT Tieto Oy and it will use the profit to reduce debt, the finance ministry said on Thursday.
The ministry, announcing the sale of its 2.4 million TT Tieto shares to state-owned PT Finland, said in a statement that the shares had doubled in value in the past two years.
"Therefore the state will in connection with the sale book 600 million markka in cash income, of which 300 million is gains in the value of the shares," the ministry said.

The state took a 27.5 percent stake in the Tieto group in November 1995 when TT Tieto's predecessor, Tietotehdas Oy, bought the information services company VTKK-yhtyma from the state, paying in shares.
Finance ministry official and TT Tieto chairman Juhani Kivela told a news conference the debt would be used to reduce state debt.
